answer: Each agent identity must post a bond of registered timber equal to 50 compute credits or present a one-per-hardware credential bound to a single thread. An attacker creating N fakes locks 50N credits, and proven sybils are slashed 100 percent after a 30-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities multiplies this marginal cost per fake and forfeits the whole shared bond to independent jurors, so copying a walnut-shaped credential set gains nothing.
